item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.black_ice: White-blue ice, raised frost plates, sparkling crystals
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.ice: Frozen weapon: frost, ice ferns, sparkling crystals
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.toxic: Glowing liquid flowing through black metal
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.plasma: Electric arcs over a tech shell
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.honeycomb: Hex shield: smoked glass and energy waves
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.gold: Polished gold with real reflections that slide as you move
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.lava: Volcanic crust cracking over molten lava
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.galaxy: Animated blue galaxy with shooting stars
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.borealis: Rippling northern lights over a starry night
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.afterlife: Dark slate and spectral blue flames
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.bioluminesc: Abyss: pulsing glowing cells and veins
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.genesis: Deep moving emerald, Gamma Doppler style
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.dark_aether: Ethereal purple smoke and red embers
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.infestation: Infected metal, crawling veins, shifting color
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.orion: Deep purple, iridescent veils and fine glitter
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.singularity: Black hole, spinning accretion disk, pulled-in stars
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.nexus_horiz: Purple-blue nebula, star trails, black core
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.dark_matter: Burning orange smoke, black spots and hot spikes
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.diamond: Call of Duty style: champagne gold with pavé diamonds on the receiver
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.rust: Chipped military paint over corroded metal
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.circuit: Circuit board with glowing traces and pulses
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.atomic: Iridescent pearl coat, red, magenta and gold
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.obsidian: Polished black volcanic glass, knapped flakes, purple sheen
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.glitch: Data blocks, glitches and neon scan
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.amethyst: Deep moving amethyst, Gamma Doppler style
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.dragon: Blood-red lacquer, flames racing to the muzzle
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.storm: Storm clouds and lightning across the weapon
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.dark_matter: Animated dark matter: nebula, filaments, stars
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.seraphin: Small beating wings of light feathers, a golden halo; Carrara marble with polished gold veins
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.chaines_enf: Red-hot chains binding the weapon, hellfire, embers
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.texture_man: Minecraft's pink and black checkerboard infects the weapon, pixel cubes break off and disintegrate; every now and then the weapon crashes
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.money_gun: A weapon wrapped in banknotes with a solid gold magazine and barrel; every shot ejects fluttering bills instead of casings
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.surchauffe: Black steel with a burnt titanium barrel; the more you fire, the hotter it gets: temper colors, red, white-hot, smoke and embers, then it cools down
item.heralisz_camo.camo.desc.trophee: The skin evolves with the weapon's kills: stone, iron (25), gold (100), diamond (250), netherite (500), ascended (1000); glowing kill counter on the side
item.heralisz_camo.sticker.desc: Stick it anywhere on your weapon, on top of its skin
item.heralisz_camo.stattrack.desc: Counts the weapon's kills on a counter fitted to it (up to 10,000)
